Handyman services

The whole to-do list, handled

Repairs, installs, and upkeep around the house. If it's on your list, it's probably on this one. Small jobs are welcome, and most are done in a single visit.

Right tools · every visit
TV mountingAny size, on drywall, brick, or above the fireplace. Cables hidden in the wall on request.
Chandeliers & light fixturesChandeliers, pendants, vanity lights, and flush mounts hung and wired safely, even in tall foyers.
Drywall repair & patchingHoles, cracks, water damage, texture matching, and a finish ready for paint.
Interior paintingRooms, accent walls, trim, doors, and touch-ups with clean lines and no mess left behind.
Furniture assemblyIKEA, Wayfair, Amazon, office desks, beds, cribs, and anything else that came in a flat box.
Shelving, mirrors & wall artFloating shelves, closet systems, garage racks, heavy mirrors, and gallery walls anchored properly.
Doors, locks & hardwareSticking doors, new deadbolts, smart locks, handles, hinges, and storm door repair.
Minor plumbingFaucets, toilets, garbage disposals, shower heads, leaky supply lines, and P-trap swaps.
Caulking & groutTubs, showers, sinks, windows, and baseboards re-sealed so water stays where it belongs.
Tile & flooringCracked tile replacement, backsplashes, vinyl plank, laminate, and transition strips.
Trim, baseboards & moldingInstall or replace baseboards, casing, crown, and quarter round with tight, filled joints.
Windows, blinds & screensScreen repair, weatherstripping, blinds and curtain rods, and drafty window fixes.
Deck & fence repairLoose boards, wobbly railings, gate hinges, post repair, and staining or sealing.
Pressure washingDriveways, walkways, siding, decks, and patios brought back to clean.
Gutter cleaning & repairClean-outs, re-hanging sagging sections, downspout fixes, and guard installs.
Move-in / move-out punch listsEverything the inspector or landlord flagged, knocked out in one visit.

Don't see it? Text a photo of the job. If Adnan can do it, he'll tell you what it takes. If he can't, he'll say so and point you to someone who can.

Electrical work

Done by a real electrician

Adnan is a trained electrician, not a handyman guessing at wiring. Everything is done to code, with the power off and tested before he leaves.

To code · tested · safe
Outlets & switchesNew outlets, replacements, USB outlets, GFCI in kitchens and baths, dimmers, 3-way switches.
Ceiling fansNew fan installs with a fan-rated box, replacements, remotes, and wobble fixes.
Recessed & under-cabinet lightingCan lights, LED wafer lights, kitchen under-cabinet strips, and closet lighting.
TroubleshootingDead outlets, tripping breakers, flickering lights, and buzzing switches diagnosed and fixed.
Breakers & panel workBreaker replacements, new circuits, labeling, and panel tune-ups.
EV charger installationLevel 2 chargers for Tesla, Ford, Hyundai, Rivian, and more, with the dedicated circuit to feed it.
Smoke & CO detectorsHardwired and interconnected detectors replaced or added, so every floor is covered.
Doorbells & camerasRing, Nest, and other video doorbells wired in, plus transformer upgrades when needed.
Outdoor & landscape lightingPorch lights, floodlights, motion sensors, and weatherproof outlets for the patio.
Thermostats & exhaust fansSmart thermostat wiring (including C-wire fixes) and bathroom exhaust fan replacement.
Surge protectionWhole-house surge protectors so a storm doesn't take out your TV, fridge, and computers.
Appliance hookupsDryer, range, dishwasher, microwave, and hot tub connections done to code.

Safety first. Adnan will tell you honestly when a job needs a permit or a full panel upgrade, and won't cut corners to save a few dollars.

How it works

Three steps. No runaround.

Call or text with the job

A quick description or a photo is all Adnan needs. You'll hear back the same day.

Get a straight price

Most jobs get a firm quote up front. No surprise fees, no "we'll see when we get there."

Adnan shows up and fixes it

On time, with the right tools and parts, and the area cleaned up before he heads out.

Why people call Adnan

Small business. Big standards.

Electrician-level skill

The person doing your handyman work is qualified to do your electrical work too. That's rare.

Honest, up-front pricing

You'll know the cost before the work starts. Small jobs get small prices.

Shows up when he says

You'll get a real arrival window and a text when he's on the way.

Respects your home

Shoe covers, drop cloths, and a full clean-up. You won't know he was there, except the job is done.

One call, many trades

Hang the TV, add the outlet behind it, and patch the old holes. One visit instead of three contractors.

Work that lasts

Proper anchors, rated boxes, and real materials. Nothing gets "good enough."
